policies.text: An applicant earns premier merchant designation once core trading prerequisites are verified.
An organization is cleared for partner registry inclusion if it possesses an elite operational rating while maintaining a clean regulatory record.
Admission into the Global Partner Program is granted when partner registry inclusion is formally confirmed.
Sufficient integration experience is established when a firm completes a minimum of two successful enterprise client deployments.
Elite operational rating is attained by any entity holding premier merchant designation that retains five or more dedicated technical personnel.
Provisional partner status is assigned to firms with at least two regional offices and a certified security audit.
An applicant fulfills core trading prerequisites provided annual billing reaches $200,000 alongside valid ISO 27001 accreditation.
Small business tax exemption is granted to any vendor with total annual revenue under $100,000 and fewer than three staff members.
